title: Place linked screen artboards on the Board
summary: A screenshot-only Board would be visually useful but unable to support component inspection, source navigation, proposal targeting or future structured screen editing. Introduce a ScreenArtboard object linked to a ViewItem, with snapshot-underlay mode, component regions, device contract, navigation anchors and source provenance.
acceptance_criteria: A ScreenArtboard object links to a StudioNativeDocument.ViewItem by stable view ID and imported revision.
The artboard can render snapshot underlay, device frame, safe-area contract, component regions and navigation anchors independently.
Selecting an artboard exposes view source path, component IDs, states, actions and navigation evidence from imported truth.
Snapshot-only, structured-overlay and missing-snapshot states are visually and semantically distinct.
Board overrides never mutate the imported ViewItem and can be reset to imported truth.
At least one HumbleSudoku or MyVltavaRun fixture places multiple linked screens and navigation anchors on a Board.
Focused tests cover missing view IDs, refreshed imports, appearance changes and artboard serialization.

evidence.note: Native inspection is snapshot-first and contract-driven.
Views already connect screenshots, components and navigation.
ViewItem carries source, components, states, actions, navigation and snapshot evidence.
Snapshots are resolved by appearance from imported asset truth.

blocked_by.reason: Required Board foundation must be solved first.

trigger.source_ref: HumbleStudio Board architecture finding HS-BAR-007, requested by Jan.
